name: A family of diagnostic reagents, each of which when applied to a unit or a set makes visible only those units carrying one specific structural feature and stays dark on the rest; a selective detector keyed to a single chosen feature, reporting which units it reveals, so a feature that is invisible in the bare description is made to show.

phase_0.domain_name: A family of diagnostic reagents, each of which when applied to a unit or a set makes visible only those units carrying one specific structural feature and stays dark on the rest; a selective detector keyed to a single chosen feature, reporting which units it reveals, so a feature that is invisible in the bare description is made to show.

VINIT.justification: The unexamined set of units before any selective pressure or diagnostic application.

TANCH.justification: The closure of the diagnostic session where all results are bound into a single document.

AFWD.justification: The forward transformation of data by exposing it to the selective detection pattern.

AREV.justification: The reverse operation where the reagent is neutralized or the signal is digitally suppressed for re-analysis.

CLINK.justification: Sequential composition of multiple diagnostic tests across the same unit population.

IMSCRIB.justification: The persistent identity of a unit that remains constant irrespective of whether it is revealed or hidden.

FSPLIT.justification: The system forks into a detection branch for matching features and a dark branch for non-matching units.

FFUSE.justification: The integration of the revealed and dark paths to account for the total population without loss of mass or data.

EVALT.justification: The positive affirmative branch where a unit carries the specific structural feature.

EVALF.justification: The negative branch where the unit fails the diagnostic and remains dark.

ENGAGR.justification: A state where signal and noise are indistinguishable or a unit possesses multiple overlapping features simultaneously.

IFIX.justification: The permanent and irreversible recording of specialized detection events into the system ROM.

phase_3.void_description: Undifferentiated data before diagnostic reagent contact
phase_3.true_description: Visualized unit possessing the selective feature
phase_3.false_description: Invisible unit lacking the selective feature
phase_3.both_description: Partial match or overlapping feature signatures held in suspension

steps.domain_action: Uninitialized data stream provides the target unit population
System recognizes the internal self-consistent identity of each data unit
Establishing the connection between the observer and the unit set
Reagent logic branches the population based on structural compatibility
Detection of the affirmative feature triggers a fluorescence event
The positive signal is amplified for sensor capture
The detection of the feature is recorded in the permanent diagnostic log
The diagnostic excitation is attenuated on the non-matching units
Units failing the reagent check transit the dark arm
Recombining revealed and dark units to verify mass/charge conservation
Identity confirmation ensures no data points were lost during split
Analysis of units caught in edge-case noise or dual-label interference
Chaining the result to the final reporting function
Terminal anchor seals the diagnostic record and exits processing
